class.name: GDScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language.
class.description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language, saved with the [code].gd[/code] extension. The script extends the functionality of all objects that instantiate it. Calling [method new] creates a new instance of the script. [method Object.set_script] extends an existing object, if that object's class matches one of the script's base classes. If you are looking for GDScript's built-in functions, see [@GDScript] instead.

method.name: new
snapshot_cancel_static_awaits
method.description: Drops the calls suspended in an [code]await[/code] that run on no object (static functions and lambdas without [code]self[/code]) in every script except those whose file is in [param keep], so none of them resumes on a loaded game.

method.name: snapshot_get_awaits
method.description: Returns the calls of [param owner] that are suspended in an [code]await[/code], or, when [param owner] is a [GDScript], its static calls. Each entry names the function as [method snapshot_get_lambda] does ([code]index[/code] is empty for a function that is not a lambda), and holds [code]hash[/code] (identifies the compiled code), [code]ip[/code], [code]line[/code], [code]defarg[/code], [code]stack[/code] (the call's local and temporary values), [code]awaiting[/code] (the [Signal] it waits for), [code]state[/code] (the suspended call itself) and [code]completed[/code] (the earlier call of the same chain whose [code]completed[/code] signal it emits when it ends, or [code]null[/code] for its own). For saving a game while functions wait in an [code]await[/code].

method.name: snapshot_get_lambda
method.description: Returns where the GDScript lambda [param callable] is written and what it captured, or an empty [Dictionary] for any other [Callable]: [code]script[/code] (the path of the file), [code]class[/code] (the inner class names leading to it), [code]function[/code] (the function it is written in), [code]index[/code] (the index of the lambda in that function, then in each lambda it is nested in), [code]captures[/code] and [code]self[/code] (the object it runs on, or [code]null[/code]). A lambda is named as hot reload names it, so the description stays valid while that function's lambdas keep their order. For saving a game's connections and stored callables.

method.name: snapshot_make_await
method.description: Makes again a suspended call that [method snapshot_get_awaits] described, run by [code]owner[/code] in [param info] ([code]null[/code] for a static function or a lambda without [code]self[/code]) and emitting [code]completed[/code] of the call in [code]completed[/code], if any. Its stack starts empty: fill it with [method snapshot_set_await_stack]. It waits for nothing until its [code]_signal_callback[/code] method, bound to the call, is connected to a signal with [constant Object.CONNECT_ONE_SHOT]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the script's code changed since, or [code]owner[/code] does not run that script.

method.name: snapshot_make_await_token
method.description: Returns a suspended-call object that runs nothing and only emits [code]completed[/code]. It stands for the first call of a chain that has already resumed, so the calls waiting for that chain resume when its restored last call ends.

method.name: snapshot_make_lambda
method.description: Makes the lambda that [method snapshot_get_lambda] described, with the captures and [code]self[/code] in [param info]. Returns an invalid [Callable] if the script no longer has a lambda there that takes as many captures and uses [code]self[/code] the same way.

method.name: snapshot_set_await_stack
method.description: Puts [param stack], as [method snapshot_get_awaits] returned it, into a call [method snapshot_make_await] made. Returns [code]false[/code] if the size does not match.
